big: A client with ₹30 lakh is told she cannot open a regular PMS account. A client with ₹60 lakh can. The rule is a SEBI minimum of ₹50 lakh. What does the extra money buy? A portfolio built in your name.

lines: How is a PMS different from a mutual fund?

In a PMS, a SEBI-registered portfolio manager runs your portfolio under a signed agreement. Your shares sit in a separate account in your own name, not in a pool. You can log in and see exactly what was bought for you.
